summary: Close the remaining Agent public Evidence Ledger error-authority spoof: arbitrary caller-thrown Proxy/getter exceptions must never be mistaken for Agent-generated validation reasons. Normalize them to the fixed UNREADABLE_INPUT code before any append while preserving all already-proven zero-mutation, E-1, public factory/facet, fresh-process reopen, V3 attestation, and strict failure behavior. Agent-only; Core/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow are read-only/out of scope.
designIntent: Replace message-prefix trust with an Agent-internal, caller-unforgeable validation-failure discriminator (or an equivalent separation), while normalizing all Proxy/getter/trap exceptions to the fixed public UNREADABLE_INPUT reason before append.

required.verify: One clean AlembicAgent follow-up commit based exactly on 5d62e9e662eff045097f2da3707709cbd88f56ce; report parent, commit, tree, and changed files. No Core/Main/Plugin/Test/Wakeflow/vendor edits.

Through the built @alembic/agent/production export, prove Proxy ownKeys and property-getter inputs that throw caller-controlled Errors whose messages already use the Agent capture prefix are rejected with the exact Agent-owned ALEMBIC_AGENT_EVIDENCE_LEDGER_CAPTURE_INVALID:UNREADABLE_INPUT reason. For each case prove ledger file existence/bytes and snapshot/store state are unchanged and the next valid capture remains the unconsumed E-1.
Retain the existing 26 malformed-draft cases, valid capture/read/fresh-process reopen path, same store/snapshot/evidence identity, serialized V3 attestation, and prior 11 strict fault cards.

Run build:check/build, focused production ledger/EvidenceLedgerStore/durable semantic runtime/AgentRuntime tests, built strict public consumer, public imports, full npm run check, scoped format/lint, and git diff --check. Report exact counts and distinguish pre-existing warnings.

Change only AlembicAgent's public capture validation/error-authentication boundary and its existing tests/probes. Preserve the single private EvidenceLedgerStore, public factory/facets, valid reason codes, redaction, strict hydration/snapshot, and AgentRuntime sharing; do not implement downstream Main work or alter Core contracts.

Explain why matching a caught Error by public message prefix lets callers forge internally generated validation reasons, how the replacement distinguishes Agent-created validation failures from arbitrary caller exceptions, and where normalization still occurs before E-n allocation or JSONL mutation.

targetTasks.summary: Replace public error-prefix trust with an unforgeable internal validation-error distinction, add built-public Proxy/getter spoof regressions, and return exact zero-side-effect plus unchanged authority-chain evidence.
